metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare vegetation cover near the Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth between 1984 and 2021. For vegetation analysis, NDVI is a good indicator. Key considerations: 1. Time period: 1984 vs 2021 2. Location: Rosetta branch of Nile mouth (near Alexandria, Egypt) 3. Data sources: For 1984, I'll use Landsat 5. For 2021, I'll use Landsat 8. 4. Cloud masking is important for accurate NDVI calculation 5. Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels Strategy: 1. Define a geometry around the Rosetta Nile branch (point with buffer) 2. Get Landsat 5 collection for 1984 and Landsat 8 for 2021 3. Apply cloud masking and calculate NDVI 4. Compute mean NDVI for each year in the region 5. Compare the values and determine if 1984 had greater vegetation Potential issues: - Landsat 5 started in 1984, so there might be limited data - Need to handle cloud masking properly - Check for valid pixels after processing ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const rosettaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([30.6, 31.5]); // Rosetta branch coordinates const region = rosettaPoint.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the point const start1984 = '1984-01-01'; const end1984 = '1984-12-31'; const start2021 = '2021-01-01'; const end2021 = '2021-12-31'; // Function to mask clouds for Landsat function maskLandsatClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 3; const shadowBitMask = 1 << 4; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(shadowBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 2. Data Acquisition for 1984 (Landsat 5) let landsat5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1984, end1984) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskLandsatClouds); let landsat5Count = landsat5.size().getInfo(); // If no Landsat 5, try fallback if (landsat5Count === 0) { landsat5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1984, end1984) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskLandsatClouds); landsat5Count = landsat5.size().getInfo(); } // Data Acquisition for 2021 (Landsat 8) let landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2021, end2021) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskLandsatClouds); let landsat8Count = landsat8.size().getInfo(); // Check for empty collections if (landsat5Count === 0 || landsat8Count === 0) { print(`1984 Images: ${landsat5Count}, 2021 Images: ${landsat8Count}`); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const ndvi1984 = landsat5.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); const ndvi2021 = landsat8.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); // 4. Calculate statistics and check valid pixels const stats1984 = ndvi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1984 = stats1984.NDVI_mean; const mean2021 = stats2021.NDVI_mean; const count1984 = stats1984.NDVI_count; const count2021 = stats2021.NDVI_count; // Check for no valid pixels if (count1984 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { print(`1984 Pixels: ${count1984}, 2021 Pixels: ${count2021}`); print("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer print(`1984 NDVI: ${mean1984?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count1984}`); print(`2021 NDVI: ${mean2021?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2021}`); // Check for calculation failure if (mean1984 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean1984) || isNaN(mean2021) || Math.abs(mean1984) > 1 || Math.abs(mean2021) > 1) { print("C3"); return; } // Determine final answer if (mean1984 > mean2021) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
